note: Cross-language parity vector for the signed body envelope (ticket 64; version 2 added by ticket 01). TEST-ONLY secret and account salt: this file lives in the test suite and must never be copied into a deployment. The top-level fields are the committed version 1 vector. The `v2_demo` subsection is the version 2 vector whose claims add `kind: "demo"`: {version, kind, call_id, agent_id, body_hash, issued_at_ms, expires_at_ms}, and the HMAC covers all of them. The v2 body hash and minted fingerprint were computed with stable JSON + sha256 (exactly voni/src/lib/agents/fingerprint.ts) and cross-checked with Python's json/hashlib; the v2 signature was computed with HMAC-SHA-256 and cross-checked against `openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac` and Python's hmac. So the Python verifier and the app's signer cannot drift apart silently. The expiry is a vector value, not the production TTL: that number is the open bound envelope.ttl_ms owned by ticket 04.
